description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR3, after fz-tfn.62's retained-target commits. Types::intersect(closure_lit, surface) merges the surface into the literal's ArrowSig (sigs.rs ~299-326 specialize_lit_arrow), but a lone lit clause's value set is decided by fn_id + captures alone (emptiness.rs ~194-226), so every surface mints another Ty for one callable value; every duplicate identity in the measured sample is a callable. Keep the literal and its surface constraint as distinct factors of one clause and specialize on read; specialize_lit_arrow (construction) and specialize_callable_clause (mod.rs ~3112, read) are one computation written twice; fold them. Inventory every pos.len()==1 / lit-bearing ArrowSig reader first. Tests: two_surfaces_over_one_closure_intern_once, anonymous-vs-branded callable controls.
title: One Ty per callable value
